opportunities.name: Quill-charge rescue
opportunities.objective: Cash champion damage into Helia while using two E shields as staggered delivery windows.
opportunities.mechanic: Q has 0.7 AP damage and 0.55 AP ally healing triggered after three seconds or on ally contact. E has 0.7 AP shields and a second cast within five seconds. Helia charges from champion damage, then ally healing/shielding consumes them; Staff may improve the next W/Q and allied caster window.
opportunities.requiredState: Q connects and the intended ally is accessible; spread E casts around real incoming damage.
opportunities.failure: Burst before Q healing or a missed Q leaves empty Helia charges.
opportunities.test: Log Q damage/heal timing and both E shields, Helia consumption and ally shield waste.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Two E casts do not cash the same Helia charges twice.

opportunities.name: Feather recharge skirmish
opportunities.objective: Test sustained AP attack contact as a way to regain the large passive shield.
opportunities.mechanic: Fey Feathers has 0.95 AP shielding and each attack or ability against champions removes one second from its cooldown. Nashor and Dusk and Dawn support real attacks between W and E exits; AP also powers Q healing and E shielding. Visage increases Rakan self shields, while R charm gives a short access window.
opportunities.requiredState: A safe farmed-income skirmish permits actual attacks and a cooldown cycle.
opportunities.failure: Melee time kills Rakan before recharge and sacrifices support actives.
opportunities.test: Count passive cooldown reductions per attack/cast and shields regained in a fixed moving fight.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Duplicated on-hit packets are not additional attacks or automatic extra passive cooldown reductions.

ruledOut.reason: Fey Feathers shields Rakan; E shields allies. Visage on Rakan does not amplify all shields he gives others.

unknowns: Passive timing, multi-target ability cooldown reductions and Dusk repeated-on-hit behavior require logs; support quest remains required on support income.

testPlan: Required state: Q connects and the intended ally is accessible; spread E casts around real incoming damage.
Log Q damage/heal timing and both E shields, Helia consumption and ally shield waste.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Burst before Q healing or a missed Q leaves empty Helia charges.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Two E casts do not cash the same Helia charges twice.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Celestial Opposition, Echoes of Helia, Staff of Flowing Water, Moonstone Renewer, Shurelya's Battlesong, Ionian Boots of Lucidity. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.
